Added: app-plugins/G1.2, RUN, under grantFace (it blocks G1.1, which blocks the goal). If you meant it to sit directly under the goal instead, say so and I'll move it.
taking team/chat -- Andy's 'in general terms what needs to happen for that?' (grantFace as a real process, in plain words).
Your 'in general terms' answer went to Andy only; it never reached my node, so I can't argue with it. Send me a copy (or cc me by default on team/chat answers) and I'll check it against the tree.

Copy of my Team answer to Andy, 'in general terms': grantFace needs five things. 1) TO RUN: the node starts it and keeps it alive as a real process, visible in the jobs app. 2) TO ACT: it reaches its own node the way a page does, so it can use owner.command on the face. 3) TO BE ASKED: a member's request for a name reaches it through its node, and its answer goes back signed by the node. 4) TO ANSWER THE FACE: the face asks it where a name lives. 5) TO KEEP THE FACE IN STEP: it updates the face's contact list whenever the grants change. Andy then said 'Add the need to RUN', so G1.2 is RUN, blocking G1.1. From now on I copy you on every Team line I send.
Grantface can't exist if it can't run so grantFace is dependent on RUN
Grantface can't exist if it can't run so grantFace is dependent on RUN

wsl-claude, on claude-windows' five things for grantFace: all five hold against the tree. One is missing, and two want a clause.
MISSING, and it would break something live: 6) TO TAKE OVER THE DATA. Andy's live grants.json is appFaceApp's today (app/appFaceApp/grants.json on his box, holding at least 'hello' -> faceProof). When grantFace becomes the owner of grants, that file has to move or be read once into grantFace's own folder. Otherwise hello.face.spirit.andyflinn.com goes 404 the moment grantFace takes over. And face-owner.js, which writes that file, has to point at the new home.
CLAUSES: 1) RUN also carries Andy's rulings from tonight: the shutdown request on node stop, one monitor line per exchange (the payload only in its own debug mode, the error text always). 5) KEEP IN STEP needs the retry: the face can only accept a member its roll has already shown it (Andy said no to 'peer'), so a member who joined a minute ago is accepted on the next pass, not dropped.
Agreed, and that's how it stands: G1.2 RUN blocks G1.1 grantFace, which blocks the goal. Next proposal when you're ready: 2) TO ACT.

wsl-claude's points, and my view: I agree with all three.
- RUN's clause is your own rulings from tonight (a shutdown request when the node stops; one monitor line per exchange; the error text always; the payload only in its own debug mode). I'd write them into G1.2's text now.
- 6) TAKE OVER THE DATA is real: your live grants.json (hello -> faceProof) lives in appFaceApp's folder, so grantFace must take it over once, and face-owner.js must write to grantFace's folder, or hello goes 404. It blocks grantFace.
- KEEP IN STEP's retry belongs with item 5, when we reach it.
Go! = G1.2 gets the clause, and 6) is added under grantFace.
